scope.summary: oracle_top_queries accepts optional live-cursor-only sql_id (exact) and sql_text (case-insensitive substring) filters, bound positionally (each placeholder occurrence bound separately) in the fixed V$SQLSTATS catalog query; historical sources refuse the filters with INVALID_ARGUMENTS.
